component.name: Shadow Line
component.summary: Interactive globe showing real-time daylight and sunrise/sunset times

description.p: Shadow Line displays an interactive 3D globe with the day/night terminator showing where sunlight currently falls on Earth. Configure your favourite locations to see their sunrise and sunset times at a glance.
Spin the globe by dragging horizontally. Add locations from a list of major world cities or enter custom coordinates.
Custom locations now auto-detect timezone from coordinates using a bundled timezone boundary grid.
Locations are editable after creation via context menu.
UTC offset picker and DST toggle for manual timezone adjustment.
Improved location list UX with natural solar event phrasing and clear noon indicator.
Migrated globe rendering to hardware-accelerated GLES 2.0 with enhanced lifecycle stability.
Visual refinements including sun corona effect and cleaner polar day/night indicators.
Restricted application permissions to Location only.
